subject: general
question: In how many languages was the new text-to-speech AI model which launched by Sarvam AI in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian AI startup **Sarvam AI** launched a sophisticated **text-to-speech (TTS)** model in **May 2025** (as per recent industry roadmaps) that supports a total of **11 languages**.
 
• This AI model is designed to provide high-quality, natural-sounding voice synthesis for the **Indian population**, focusing on the unique linguistic nuances of the subcontinent.
 
• The **11 languages** covered by the model include **English** and **10 major Indian languages**: **Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu**.
 
• The primary goal of this launch is to enable **voice-first applications**, making technology more accessible to people who prefer or require audio-based interactions in their native tongue.
 
• By supporting **11 languages**, Sarvam AI aims to bridge the **digital divide** and foster **digital inclusion** across various states in India.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is 11__.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sarvam AI:**
 
 
• It is a **Bengaluru-based** AI startup founded by **Vivek Raghavan** and **Pratyush Kumar**, who were instrumental in the **AI4Bharat** initiative.
 
• The company focuses on developing a "full-stack" for **Generative AI** tailored specifically for **India's diverse needs**.
 
• Sarvam AI has received significant backing, including a **$41 million Series A** funding round led by **Lightspeed Venture Partners**, **Peak XV Partners**, and **Khosla Ventures**.
 
 
 
• **Model Characteristics:**
 
 
• The TTS model is optimized for **low latency** and **high-quality prosody**, ensuring that the synthesized speech sounds human-like rather than robotic.
 
• It is part of a broader suite of models, including **Large Language Models (LLMs)** and **speech-to-text** tools, intended to build **sovereign AI** capabilities for India.
 
• Prior to the TTS model, the company released **OpenHathi**, which was the first **Hindi-focused LLM** built on top of Meta's **Llama 2**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Indic AI Ecosystem:**
 
 
• The development of models in **11 languages** is a significant milestone for **Indic AI**, as most global models primarily focus on Western languages.
 
• **Data Diversity:** The training involves massive **Indic datasets** to capture regional accents and dialects accurately.
 
• **Use Cases:** These models are being applied in sectors like **customer service (IVR)**, **education (audiobooks)**, **banking**, and **government service delivery**.
 
• **Strategic Importance:** Strengthening domestic AI capabilities reduces reliance on foreign tech giants and ensures **data privacy** within national borders under the **Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act** framework.
